title: a visible prefixed datasource cannot authorize a SQL-workbench query against a distinct, restricted suffix datasource; exact and legacy-alias requests for an authorized datasource still work

criteria.given: a caller entitled to see sales_payroll but denied payroll submits {"datasource":"payroll","sql":"SELECT ..."}
criteria.then: the request is rejected with UNKNOWN_DATASOURCE before a JDBC connection is opened — authorization resolves the requested id once (the same resolution the connection provider applies) and checks the RESOLVED record against the caller's role-filtered datasource map, never matching distinct datasource records through prefix tolerance (saiku#2394, CWE-863)

criteria.given: an authorized datasource is requested by its UUID or by its workspace-decorated name (the legacy aliases the saiku#1869 lookup supports)
criteria.then: the query executes: the alias is applied at RESOLUTION (getDatasourceByIdOrName), not at authorization, and the resolved record is matched by immutable id property or exact connection name

a colliding visible name (sales_payroll visible, payroll restricted) is rejected with no connection opened, and the UUID and decorated-alias requests for an authorized datasource still execute — the collision test fails on the pre-fix implementation, which matched visible names with DatasourceNameDecoration.sameConnection
